L17: # Mcp-warden: a local MCP server that injects your credentials so the agent never sees them
L18: 
L19: Most MCP setups I've seen hand the agent a token one way or another: an env var, a .env file, a config it can read. Once a token is in the context window it ends up in transcripts and within reach of any prompt injection.
L20: 
L21: mcp-warden works the other way around. Secrets live in the OS keychain, and the agent can only act through presets you define:
L22: 
L23: ```toml
L24: 
L25: [[preset]]
L26: 
L27: name = "github-read"
L28: 
L29: type = "http"
L30: base_url = "【4†https://api.github.com†api.github.com】"
L31: 
L32: auth = { type = "bearer", secret = "gh_pat" }
L33: 
L34: allowed_methods = ["GET"]
L35: 
L36: approval = "auto"
L37: 
L38: ```
L39: 
L40: The agent calls `proxy_http` with the preset name, a method and a path. mcp-warden checks the allow-list, adds the token, makes the request and returns only the response. If the method or path isn't allowed, nothing leaves your machine.
L41: 
L42: Tools it exposes:
L43: 
L44: - `list_presets`
L45: 
L46: - `proxy_http`: HTTP through a preset
L47: - `ssh_exec`: commands checked against a regex allow-list, host key verified against known_hosts
L48: 
L49: - `sftp_transfer`: allowed remote paths only
L50: 
L51: - `db_query`: Postgres, MySQL or Redis, named queries only (the agent passes parameters, never SQL)
L52: 
L53: - `get_secret_for_env`: last resort for tools that insist on env vars, always asks first
L54: 
L55: Each preset has an approval policy. It's `prompt` by default: a desktop or terminal prompt, or Approve/Deny buttons in Telegram. Every call lands in an append-only audit log.
L56: Single Rust binary, stdio transport, works with any MCP client. No cloud, no telemetry, Apache-2.0.
L57: 
L58: - Repo: 【5†https://github.com/ermoluk/mcp-warden†github.com】
L59: 
L60: - Install: `cargo install mcp-warden`, or prebuilt binaries for macOS/Linux on the releases page
L61: 
L62: I'd love feedback on the preset model. What would you need it to cover for your setup?
